sources: pin names from the EasyEDA symbol
AMS1117 datasheet (Advanced Monolithic Systems), LCSC copy https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/e6935943fc6b1bbf350a1a0f3e90dc4a.pdf
Absolute maximum ratings: input voltage 15 V; '1A low dropout voltage regulator'
Electrical characteristics: dropout 1.1 V typ / 1.3 V max at 0.8 A, current limit 900 … 1500 mA, quiescent current 5 mA typ / 11 mA max
Stability: '22µF solid tantalum on the output will ensure stability for all operating conditions … Without bypassing the adjustment terminal smaller capacitors can be used'

open: no output capacitor ESR window – the datasheet asks for 22 µF tantalum, the DevKitC fits a 22 µF ceramic
thermal resistance junction-ambient not stated (junction-case 15 °C/W): LIM.t cannot judge the regulator
operating junction range not read: tj_max_c 125 is the datasheet's thermal-regulation statement and is an assumption
